_comment: Single source of truth for all model assignments.
Run `make configure` after changing this file.
planning  — high-stakes decisions: change proposals, specs, gate-checks
review    — read-only review: code review, security scan
fast      — low-latency tasks: QA, simple transforms

profiles._comment: Named presets. Switch with: make configure PROFILE=<name>

anthropic-default._comment: Opus for planning/review, Sonnet for implementation.

anthropic-budget._comment: Sonnet everywhere except fast. Lower cost.
